text: The AI review of D335830 at revision 0f681d525bd4142095c44bfd9cbf32ecb3cc10c4 reports that test_bodyScrollsWhenContentIsTooTall removes the shared footer controls, causing the later Save tasks to read disabled from null. The component reportedly creates children only on first connection. A local experiment created a fresh dialog with createAdditionalDialog(), then removed and disposed the previous dialog; all 17 assertions in the two Save tasks reportedly passed. Check earlier destructive fixture changes when these tasks fail in the full file. The full file still reported a shared menu contrast failure, so this does not establish a passing suite. No human acceptance or landing is recorded.
title: Save tests need intact shared footer controls
